name: Tekton Upgrade
description: Brings every Tekton component in this definition up to date with one button press. A component you placed keeps the script it was placed with, even when Tekton is updated; this swaps each one for the current version, in place, with its wires and nickname. Press it after a Tekton update. The report tells you what was replaced and names any wire it could not carry over (a renamed or removed input) - reconnect those by hand. Nothing else on the canvas is touched.

inputParameters.name: upgrade
inputParameters.description: Connect a Button. One press replaces every Tekton component in this definition.

inputParameters.name: repo
inputParameters.description: Path to the Tekton repo. Empty = the one TektonInfo/TektonBackend already set for this session.

outputParameters.name: report
outputParameters.description: One line per replaced component: how many wires came along, and which were dropped - reconnect those by hand.
